::: {#def-homogeneous-network-interference .theorem}
## Homogeneous network interference

An exposure mapping exhibits homogeneous network interference with respect to a graph set $\mathcal H$ if it is [separable](#def-separability) with [positionally invariant](#def-positional-invariance) and [bounded](#def-boundedness) component functions with respect to $\mathcal H$. An NPSEM satisfies homogeneous network interference if all its exposure mappings do.
:::
